Emma P.: Quick heads-up — Jess (new hire) is joining from CET and can't make an in-person I-9 drop-in on Day 1. Can we finalize an alternate verification plan?
Rahul S.: Thanks Emma. Jess's start is next Tue 9am PT / 6pm CET, so same-day not possible for in-person.
Jess K.: yep that's right — I'm in Berlin. Happy to do a notary or video verify, whatever works.
Emma P.: Great. Two paths: 1) schedule a remote I-9 with an authorized notary + courier for signed pages, or 2) use our approved virtual I-9 vendor for a video session followed by scanned docs. Both require completed preboarding forms and benefits election link before EOD first day.
Tom I.: For laptops we can still ship to Berlin if Jess confirms shipping address by EOD Mon. ETA 2 business days. If we do video verify, please mention the courier window so hardware isn't held up.
Jess K.: I can do the video vendor — less hassle. Which docs do I need to have on hand? Passport + driver's license?
Emma P.: For virtual vendor, bring a passport OR a combination of driver's license + SSN card. I'll paste the short checklist below: 
```
Acceptable docs for virtual I-9:
- List A: U.S. Passport (if available) OR
- List B + C: State DL + Social Security card or birth certificate
- For international hires with work authorization, bring passport + work visa/permit
```
Rahul S.: Also note — benefits enrollment email goes out with a one-week deadline. If Jess needs an exception because of timezone/phone verification delays, we can extend to 14 days but need to log that. Emma, can you flag if extension is applied?
Emma P.: Yep — if we apply a benefits deadline exception I'll add a note to the employee record and CC People Ops team. Jess, if you want the 14-day extension, say so and we'll apply it now.
Jess K.: Please apply the 14-day extension — might need time to get my EU SSN docs translated. Thanks! :relaxed:
WelcomeBot: Congrats @Jess K.! Your onboarding checklist updated: "I-9 virtual verification scheduled" (pending).
Emma P.: Thanks — action items: 1) Jess to confirm video session availability window (share 3 slots), 2) Tom to hold laptop shipment until verification booked, 3) Emma to send benefits enrollment link + apply extension, 4) Rahul to confirm first-week intro schedule.
Rahul S.: I'll set up the first-week sync and calendar invites after verification is scheduled.
Jess K.: I'll DM my 3 available slots in CET now. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
